description: Semantic code search over the embedded vector index: the same ranked matches as `eg query semantic`, with the embedding-provenance envelope and the confidence verdict (issue #182).

compatibility_note.description: Discloses the daemon-path embedding compatibility caveat (issue #104).

confidence.description: The issue #221 confidence verdict (verdict, best score, thresholds, selection basis; forwarded verbatim from the daemon).

embedding_provenance.description: The issue #243 provenance envelope: query/index model identity, metric, index fingerprint, and the model-match verdict (forwarded verbatim from the daemon).

anyOf.description: Explicit marker for a pre-stamping store — never a silent absence, never a false `fresh`.

limit.description: The effective match limit (default 10, clamped to 100).

matches.description: Ranked semantic matches, daemon order (score-descending, ties by record ID); empty with a `message` marker on no-match.

confidence_band.description: Relevance band from the calibrated confidence floor (`strong` clears it, `weak` does not).

name.description: Symbol/file name (absent when the daemon row omits it).

record_id.description: Stable record ID of the matched graph record (byte-identical to `eg query semantic`).

repo_relative_path.description: Repo-relative file handle (absent when the daemon row omits it).

repository.description: Repository short handle (absent for unattributed records).

repository_id.description: Canonical ID of the owning repository (absent for unattributed records).

score.description: Cosine relevance score; rows are ranked score-descending, ties by record ID.

selection_basis.description: How the threshold was derived (corpus-calibrated confidence floor).

selection_threshold.description: The calibrated confident threshold the band was classified against.

span.description: Source span handle (start/end byte, line, column; absent when the daemon row omits it).

message.description: Present on the explicit empty answer (`no_semantic_matches`), naming the stable marker.
